---
title: "Module 04 — Meet celld"
---

## What celld is

[celld](https://github.com/denoland/celld) is a self-hosted implementation of significant parts of the Cloudflare Workers / Durable Objects model.

**Label:** evolving / experimental dependency.

## Mapping

| Open Engineering | celld |
|------------------|-------|
| Pico | Cell / Durable Object |
| Pico identity | Cell identity / address |
| Pico state | Durable state |
| Pico runtime | V8 isolate / Worker |
| Persistence | SQLite (+ S3-compatible replication) |
| Events | Request, RPC, alarm, WebSocket |
| Suspension | Hibernation |

## What this course must not do

- Redefine Pico *as* a Durable Object
- Hard-code `implementation: celld` into Pico definitions
- Claim stronger consistency or DR properties than the tested celld version provides

## Principle

```
spec:
  runtime:
    class: durable      # semantic request
# not:
#   implementation: celld
```
